storage.initialization_order_note: The host NativeString default construction writes its two zero words during placement construction before the explicit native-order writes. No external call occurs in that interval; no concurrent construction-observer or SEH equivalence claim.

actual_shared_context.live_scalar_api: const volatile std::uint32_t& actual_one_00d7a24c; captured once before placement construction.
actual_shared_context.callback_composition: The primary binds actual resource support deleting dispatch into the existing real SingletonLifetimeDomain callback; this module introduces no no-op lifecycle adapter.

constructor: Capture scalar source once, construct real owner fields and preserve bytes 31h through 37h.
Captured input AddRef/Release pair, binder call, then another pair on the same captured input.
Allocate real temporary Surface string and diagnostic deep copy, call actual support getter, return record name then temporary string, reload owner flags and conditionally increment actual counter.
Constructor exception cleanup returns active diagnostic strings and current owner name, installs base, but neither COM-releases nor returns raw slot.
binding: Overwrite +2C before captured AddRef, then reload +2C for GetDesc.
Raw uninitialized D3DSURFACE_DESC; ignore HRESULT; copy format, width, height, multisample.
Null branch clears format, width, height, flags and multisample; leaves exact kind unchanged.
No release of a previous owner COM binding.
destructor: Install surface profile, capture canonical renderer once, remove borrowed owner pointer from its actual +1B0C header, call actual support singleton.
Reload current +2C; Release and clear after callback. Reload current flags for counter decrement, then current name pointer/length for sized pool return.
Leave name words stale and install refcounted base profile.
Scalar deleting wrapper returns canonical pool slot only for flags bit zero and only after successful destructor.
reset: Captured current COM AddRef/Release pair, fresh current field for final Release, clear after callback.
Recreate with stack-passed actual device, width/height/format/multisample, quality zero, null shared handle, direct output to actual +2C.
Kind zero: CreateRenderTarget lockable FALSE. Any nonzero byte: CreateDepthStencilSurface discard TRUE. Preserve returned HRESULT, no rollback or old-slot check.
raw_array: Capture native data/count and unsigned end pointer. Return empty before reading the target-pointer storage.
Capture target once, use retained raw cursor to find first match, signed SAR-2 index, swap captured last pointer into hole when needed.
Decrement live count; preserve capacity and stale final entry. No retain, release, private collection or snapshot.

exception_handling.source_policy: C++ exception guards/catch under /EHsc encode inspected cleanup boundaries. Access violations/SEH and original CRT exception dispatcher are not implemented or runtime-proven.

repository_build.limitation: Baseline CMake does not include this new module until primary integration; the strict fixture build compiles it explicitly.

differential_fixture.original_dependencies: Original native surface pool construction/allocation/return/destruction, resource support owner/getter, real lifetime-manager cold registration/shutdown, native string resize and base destructor are executed.
boundaries: Native ordinary/array allocation and free plus the corresponding reconstructed allocation seam use real CRT malloc/free with deterministic A5 preimages.
Actual Win32 Initialize/Enter/Leave/DeleteCriticalSection APIs; no fake lock.

Native 00419CC0 getter and 00BD1120/00BD1510 allocation/return ABI boundaries bridge into the same real SizedStoragePool body used by the reconstructed path. The native trailing flag is checked as one.
Native memcpy and memmove_s boundaries use real copying; zero-length memcpy returns without inspecting a null source.
ABI-correct deterministic COM vtables model AddRef, Release, GetDesc and the two device create calls. GetDesc writes every descriptor field even while returning E_FAIL.
sequence: Construct into a real native 38h pool slot; binder AddRef callback replaces the current field with another COM object; GetDesc sees replacement, while both balanced constructor pairs use captured input.
Reset AddRef callback replaces COM again; pair uses captured object and final release uses fresh owner field.
RT and noncanonical nonzero-kind depth recreation return E_FAIL while writing direct outputs; outputs and failure codes survive.
COM destruction callback sees actual array already changed, mutates current flags and name; destructor reloads both after callback.
Odd delete flags return actual slot; native/source free stacks reuse the same address. Reused null construction sees changed live scalar word 7FC01234 and preserves exact bits at both scalar offsets.
Null binding clears metadata/flags, preserves exact A5 kind byte. Even delete flags leave the slot allocated for explicit fixture cleanup.
Empty array returns without reading an invalid target-pointer storage. Actual manager shuts down support owner; actual surface pool unlinks shared allocator head.
normalizations: Subtract relocated native image base delta from profile word.
Convert name-buffer address to null/non-null token; compare length, returned-buffer contents and actual sized-pool state separately.
Map COM pointers to stable fixture object IDs. Other 38h slot words remain byte-exact.

uncertainty: Descriptive C++ names are hypotheses, not recovered symbols.
The borrowed diagnostic record is represented by an actual second pooled NativeString and a borrowed local COM word; no externally exposed native stack-record ABI is claimed.

Surface metadata follows whatever GetDesc writes, including failed HRESULT output. Incomplete failed output leaves native uninitialized-stack behavior; the fixture intentionally provides complete output.
The context supplies already established actual shared string-pool ownership; lazy native string-pool startup is outside this module.
No native exception injection, allocation exhaustion, original CRT startup/exit, live D3D/game execution or binary replacement compatibility was tested.
Other vtable entries, intrusive zero dispatch, textures, render-target groups and renderer-wide reset traversal remain outside these eight entry points.
